        result[r, 4:7] = right_pattern

# Feature 1: Number of "endpoints" in the shape
# Count cells with degree 1 (only 1 neighbor in the shape)

def count_endpoints(section, val):
    """Count endpoints (cells with exactly 1 neighbor of same value)"""
    mask = section == val
    if mask.sum() == 0:
        return 0
    
    neighbors = np.zeros_like(mask, dtype=bool)
    neighbors[0:-1, :] = mask[1:, :]  # down neighbors
    neighbors[1:, :] = mask[0:-1, :]  # up neighbors
    neighbors[:, 0:-1] = mask[:, 1:]  # right neighbors
    neighbors[ :, 1:] = mask[:, :-1]  # left neighbors
    
    # Cells with exactly 1 neighbor
    endpoints = np.sum(neighbors, axis=0) == 1
    return int(endpoints.sum())

# Feature 2: Number of "corners" (cells with 2 diagonal neighbors but 0 orthogonal)

def count_corners(section, val):
    count = 0
    mask = section == val
    unique_rows = np.unique(np.argwhere(mask)[0])
    
    for r in unique_rows:
        # Check if any cell has 2 diagonal but 0 orthogonal neighbors
        row_mask = mask[r]
        for c in range(section.shape[1]):
            if row_mask[c]:
                # orthogonal neighbors
                left = c > 0 and row_mask[c-1]
                right = c < section.shape[1]-1 and row_mask[c+1]
                up = r > 0 and mask[r-1, c]
                down = r < section.shape[0]-1 and mask[r+1, c]
                
                ortho = left or right or up or down
                
                # diagonal neighbors
                diag = (r > 0 and c > 0 and mask[r-1, c-1]) or \
                       (r > 0 and c < section.shape[1]-1 and mask[r-1, c+1]) or \
                       (r < section.shape[0]-1 and c > 0 and mask[r+1, c-1]) or \
                       (r < section.shape[0]-1 and c < section.shape[1]-1 and mask[r+1, c+1])
                
                if not ortho and diag:
                    count += 1
    return count
